parameters: Not yet. I came here to find Tobin.
Not yet. I came here to find Tobin.
Not yet. I came here to find Tobin.
Not yet. I came here to find Tobin.
Tobin's cart never made it home last night,
and the Guild says he took the Briarwood road.
The clerk even made me take supplies.
Move with the arrow keys or a click. Hold \C[6]Shift\C[0] to dash.
S-stay back! Shoo! Go bother a squirrel!
Are you alright? I took the Guild's mission to find you.
Nobody's heard from you since last night.
Right... my cart was attacked by monsters,
Phew. Are you hurt anywhere else?
Just my ankle, and my pride—
Kael, look out! There's another one!
A slime too? Fine. One more!
That's the last of them. Can you stand?
With a hand, maybe. Gods, lad,
you came all this way for me?
Your wife marched into the Guild at dawn.
Half the request board was in her handwriting.
Come on. Let's get you home before—
A grey wolf? No... its mana is all *wrong*.
It's like looking at a river flowing uphill.
The wolf dissolves into violet smoke.
Only a small black crystal is left in the grass.
It just... dissolved? Wolves don't do that.
Cold. And the mana inside is moving the wrong way.
Kael... what in the gods' name was that thing?
I don't know. I've never seen anything like it.
Not in the Academy books, not anywhere.
Twenty years I've driven this road.
Slimes, hornets, the odd boar... never *that*.
Is that what wrecked your cart?
I didn't get a good look. Something big,
out of the dark. Then I ran.
...Let's get you home. The Guild needs to hear about this.
Open the \C[6]Menu\C[0] with \C[6]Esc\C[0] / \C[6]X\C[0] or a right click:
Items (the shard is under Key Items), Skills, Equip and Status.
Press \C[6]M\C[0] to show or hide the minimap.
\C[6]Quests\C[0], at the top of the Menu, keep track of your
current objective and the story so far.
Short again, Tobin. That's the third time this month.
I-I'll get the rest. I just need a few more days—
Kael? Wh-what are you doing here?
I could ask you the same thing.
What are you doing with these people?
You led them straight to us?
No! I swear, I don't know why they're here!
Your friend seems quite at home with these men.
Hey, kid. Ever heard the saying?
Relax, Tobin. We'll only put them to sleep for a while.
Yuki, sorry. You don't have to get mixed up in this.
Heh. Not a chance. Don't keep all the fun to yourself.
Besides, I have unfinished business with your friend.
That night in Briarwood, five months ago...
It was their cargo. They paid me to bring it
through the gate. Nobody checks an old carter's cart.
Then that wolf came out of the dark.
The cart, the crates, all of it... gone.
And they wanted every coin of it back.
Why didn't you tell me? I'd have helped you.
You'd just saved my life, lad.
How could I tell you I'd lied to you the same day?
I was told I have to apologize to you.
...But I think it should be the other way around.
...I'm sorry I got you thrown in prison, miss.
They were guarding them like treasure.
Kael pries the lid off one of the crates.
Packed in straw: black crystals, cold to the touch.
(The same as the shard from the wolf.
The mana's flowing the wrong way.)
The client pays well and doesn't give names.
Hooded types. Never once saw their faces.
Ask all you want, kid. That's all I know.
Kael. Do you know what those are?
Kael wraps one of the crystals in a cloth
and slips it into his pocket.
Someone I know will want to see it.
And I'd rather it didn't go missing on the way to the gate.
Come on. Let's take these three to the gate.
The guard can deal with them. And with the crates.
It's time I told the guard everything.
